qualification.education_qualification: +2 with Biology/Botany/Zoology, Tamil in SSLC, 2 years MPHW/HI/SI training, Graduate in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology, M.Sc/B.Sc in Social Work/Public Administration/Psychology/Home Science, +2 and 2 years ANM/MPHW(F) training, Registration with TN Nurses and Midwives Council, 10+2 and DMLT, Diploma in Nursing Therapy (DNT), D.Pharm (AYUSH)
qualification.details: Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Male) / Health Inspector Gr.II: Must have passed +2 with Biology or Botany and Zoology; Must have passed Tamil language as a subject in S.S.L.C level; Must possess two years Multi-purpose Health Worker (Male) / Health Inspector / Sanitary Inspector Course training offered by recognized Private Institution / Trust / Universities / Deemed Universities including Gandhigram Rural Institute training course certificate granted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine. Integrated Counselling Testing Centre - Counsellor: Graduate degree in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development OR diploma in Nursing with minimum 3 years of experience in HIV/AIDS; Post-graduate degree in Psychology (MA/MSc) or Social Work desirable. Reproductive Maternal New born Child Health - Counsellor: M.Sc/B.Sc Social Work / Public Administration / Psychology / Home Science / Hospital & Health Management; 1-2 Years work Experience Health Sector / relevant field, Basic Computer Skills. Auxiliary Nurse Midwife: Must have passed Higher Secondary (+2); Must have undergone two years Multi-Purpose Health Workers (Female) training Course / Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery Training Course awarded by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine; Certificate of registration issued by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme - Lab Technician: Twelfth (10+2) and 2 Years Diploma course in Medical Laboratory Technology Recognized by DME. Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapy (D.N.T.) – 2 year course approved by Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy. NRHM-Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapy (D.N.T.) – 2 year course approved by Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy. NRHM-Dispenser (Unani): D.Pharm (AYUSH) from Government an approved Indian Medicine Institution and affiliated with the Tamilnadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University.

Integrated Counselling Testing Centre - Counsellor: Graduate degree in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development OR diploma in Nursing with minimum 3 years of experience in HIV/AIDS; Post-graduate degree in Psychology (MA/MSc) or Social Work desirable. Reproductive Maternal New born Child Health - Counsellor: M.Sc/B.Sc Social Work / Public Administration / Psychology / Home Science / Hospital & Health Management; 1-2 Years work Experience Health Sector / relevant field, Basic Computer Skills. Auxiliary Nurse Midwife: Must have passed Higher Secondary (+2); Must have undergone two years Multi-Purpose Health Workers (Female) training Course / Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery Training Course awarded by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine; Certificate of registration issued by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme - Lab Technician: Twelfth (10+2) and 2 Years Diploma course in Medical Laboratory Technology Recognized by DME. Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapy (D.N.T.) – 2 year course approved by Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy. NRHM-Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing Therapy (D.N.T.) – 2 year course approved by Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy. NRHM-Dispenser (Unani): D.Pharm (AYUSH) from Government an approved Indian Medicine Institution and affiliated with the Tamilnadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Mayiladuthurai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://mayiladuthurai.nic.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Mayiladuthurai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DHS Mayiladuthurai Various Health Posts recruitment is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies announced for various health posts by the District Health Society Mayiladuthurai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for these posts ranges from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 21,000 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications vary by post and include qualifications like +2 with Biology, Graduate degrees in Psychology or Social Work, Diploma in Nursing Therapy, and D.Pharm (AYUSH).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Health Society Mayiladuthurai (DHS Mayiladuthurai).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 12/October 2024.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Health Society Mayiladuthurai, which is https://mayiladuthurai.nic.in/.
